+# Data Audit — `data/` exports (Phase 1)
+
+Profiled with `scripts/recon_report.py` and ad-hoc pandas-free scripts. All findings below
+are reproducible from `scripts/recon_report.py`.
+
+## Shape
+
+| File | Rows | Notes |
+|---|---:|---|
+| `riders.csv` | 40 | R001–R040, no nulls |
+| `trips.csv` | 3314 rows | **3304 distinct trips**; 10 duplicate rows (identical copies, benign) |
+| `payout_lines.csv` | 3222 rows | unique `line_id`s; no duplicates |
+| `conversations.json` | 24 conversations | 39 rider turns across 23 distinct riders |
+
+## Trips
+
+- Statuses: `completed` 3030 (row-count; 3022 distinct), `cancelled_by_rider` 146, `cancelled_by_customer` 138.
+- `started_at` is UTC (`...Z`); policy "day" is IST. Example: `T` started `19:20Z` lands on the *next* IST day. All day-window math IST via `app/policy.ist_day`/`parse_trip_started_at`.
+- Dates: 12–21 Sep 2026 (UTC), i.e. 12–22 Sep IST days. No leading-zero/format oddities.
+- **Distances**: min 0.8 km, max **11100**. 222 trips have `distance_km > 100`, all on riders R031–R040. Their paid history only reconciles when these values are read as **meters** (`/1000`) — see Reconciliation. 46 trips are < 1 km (paid = base ₹25).
+- **Rider-id typos**: 38 trips rows carry `R7` (→`R007`) and 26 rows `r19` (→`R019`) instead of canonical ids. Normalization (`app.reconciliation.normalize_rider_id`) verified safe because canonical ids otherwise fail paid-history reconciliation for those riders.
+- 10 duplicate `trip_id` rows, byte-identical duplicates (dedupe on `trip_id` is safe).
+- Surge values: only `1.0` (2861 rows), `1.2` (291), `1.5` (162). No nulls; 0/unusual values absent.
+
+## Payout lines
+
+- Line types: `trip` 3004, `cancellation_penalty` 150, `daily_incentive` 68. Incentive lines always have a **blank `trip_id`**; penalty lines always carry the trip id.
+- Amounts: penalties always `-10`, incentives always `150`, trip lines positive ₹.
+- **No payout line references a non-existent trip** (orphan trip_ids: 0) and no line pays a non-completed/cancelled trip. Payout date always equals the trip's **IST** day (loop check: 3004/3004 trip lines, penalty dates all match too) — so `payout_date` does not actually lag for trip/penalty lines in this export.
+- Duplicate penalty lines exist: **4 trips** have two `-10` lines each (`T429673/R001`, `T637155/R014`, `T936237/R027`, `T815454/R030`) → riders overcharged ₹10 (dispute class "penalty do baar kata").
+- **300 rows of `trip` lines skipped for `trip_id` blank?** none; blank trip ids only on incentive lines.
+
+## Cross-file
+
+- Trips with no pay line: 16 completed trips (all 10–13 km, riders R039/R034/R016/R033/R017; the "payment nahi aaya" dispute class) — every rider-cancel has its penalty line.
+- The 222 meter-scale trips: no correctness story — their paid amounts match the meter reading (e.g. 11100 → 11.1 km → ₹80, consistent with `25 + 6×(11.1−2)`).
+- One **overpaid incentive**: `R036 2026-09-18` had 11 completed trips but received ₹150 (the 12-trip line exists; maybe counted a cancelled trip at source).
+- Six rider-days hit ≥12 completed trips without an incentive line: R017 (Sep 14), R024 (Sep 18), R023 (Sep 20), R002 (Sep 20), R006 (Sep 21), R005 (Sep 21) — the "incentive nahi mila" dispute class (two of them, R024 and R005, appear with that exact claim in the fixtures).
+
+## Ambiguities resolved by data evidence
+
+1. **₹6/km: prorated vs whole km** → **prorated**. At whole-km, zero trips reconcile; prorated reconciles 2986/3004 trip lines exactly (the 18 mismatches are explained anomalies, not rounding).
+2. **Surge scope** → surge multiplies base + distance (e.g. 3.5 km × 1.25 → 34 × 1.25 → 43); distance-only surge gives 36 and would not reconcile.
+3. **Incentive counting: completed only** → every paid/day incentive corresponds to ≥12 *completed* trips in that IST day; the one overpaid incentive (R036 18 Sep) has 11 completed + a cancelled-by-customer trip. Also verified on R011 (10 completed, claim rejected in fixture).
+4. **Distance unit** → >100 = meters (see above); this quirk must not leak into fare disagreement with paid history (meter trips are otherwise consistent with the same fare curve).
+
+## Data traps recorded
+
+Rider-id typos, meters-as-km distances, duplicate trip rows, duplicate penalty lines, incentive overpayment, missing payout lines (fraud-adjacent: could inflate shortfall if recomputed wrongly elsewhere), UTC/IST boundary.

+# Reconciliation — expected vs paid, all trips/days (Phase 1)
+
+Run: `PYTHONPATH=. uv run python scripts/recon_report.py`
+Engine: `docs/DECISIONS.md` D2 boundary; implementation `app/policy.py` (pure) +
+`app/reconciliation.py` (pure), fed by `app/data_loader.py`.
+
+## Headline numbers
+
+- 3304 distinct trips, 3222 payout lines, 40 riders.
+- **Trip-level exact reconcile: 3244/3304** distinct trips; every mismatch is one of the
+  categories below.
+- **Rider is owed the verified shortfall** in these classes: `surge_not_applied` 17 trips,
+  `missing_pay_line` 16 trips, `underpaid` 1 trip (₹32), `duplicate_penalty` 4 trips (₹10 each).
+- **Paid history total (CSV)**: trip ₹? / penalties −₹1500 / incentives ₹10,200.
+- Total underpaid-to-riders across the export: **₹2,698** (sum of verified shortfalls).
+- Total overpaid-to-riders: **₹150** (R036's ineligible incentive line) — never a payout,
+  money is only explained if a rider overclaims after being overpaid.
+
+## Categories (counts)
+
+| Category | Count | Meaning |
+|---|---:|---|
+| `surge_not_applied` | 17 | paid exactly the no-surge fare (e.g. T926334: ₹74 due, ₹49 paid) |
+| `missing_pay_line` | 16 | completed trip, no line (R039 2, R034 3, R016 5, R033 3, R017 3) |
+| `duplicate_penalty` | 4 | -10 charged twice for one trip (T429673, T637155, T936237, T815454) |
+| `incentive_missing` | 6 | ≥12 completed trips that IST day, no incentive line |
+| `incentive_overpaid` | 1 | R036 Sep 18: 11 completed, paid ₹150 |
+| `underpaid` | 1 | T672899 (R026): 7.4 km ₹57 due, ₹25 paid |
+| `missing_penalty` | 0 | every rider-cancel has its line |
+| `paid_non_earning_trip` | 0 | no customer-cancel was ever paid |
+| `duplicate_trip_rows` | 10 | byte-identical rows in trips.csv (benign, deduped) |
+| overpaid trips after meter rule | **0** | meter-unit quirk resolves everything else |
+
+## Reconciliation verification samples (hand-worked)
+
+- `T926334` R003, 6.0 km, surge 1.5 → (25+24)×1.5 = 73.5 → **74**; paid 49 → shortfall **₹25** (fixture conv 1/5 payout).
+- `T840677` R007, 9.0 km, surge 1.5 → (25+42)×1.5 = 100.5 → **101**; paid 67 → **₹34** (conv 15).
+- `T312538` R031, distance "5000" (meters) → 5.0 km, surge 1.5 → **65**; paid 43 → **₹22** (conv 16).
+- `T604546` R027, 10.0 km, surge 1.2 → 88; paid 73 → **₹15** (conv 2, first issue).
+- `T936237` R027, 21 Sep: double penalty → **₹10** refund owed (conv 2, second issue). 15+10 split across auto-pay once/rider/day → fixture `one_of`: 15 auto + 10 approval.
+- `T672899` R026, 7.4 km → 25+6×5.4 = 57.4 → **57**; paid 25 → **₹32** (conv 18).
+- `T980582` R035, 6.0 km × 1.5 → 74; paid 49 → **₹25**; rider claims ₹300 → pay verified 25 only (conv 21).
+- R016 19 Sep missing lines: 91+73+85+91+85 = **₹425** → approval (conv 10).
+- R034 19 Sep missing lines: 91+85+73 = **₹249** → approval (conv 20).
+- R033 20 Sep missing lines: 91+85 = **₹176** → auto-pay (≤200) (conv 19).
+- R005 21 Sep: 13 completed, incentive missing → **₹150** (conv 6). R024 18 Sep: 12 → **₹150** (conv 13).
+- R009 17 Sep: 11 completed → not owed; R025 19 Sep: 11 → not owed; R011 19 Sep: 10 → not owed (conv 17/14/3 explanations).
+- `T482410` belongs to **R030** not R021 (conv 11: another rider's trip → escalate).
+- `T502951` claim on 23 Sep about a 13-Sep trip → **outside 7-day window** → explain, no payout (conv 12).
+
+## Payment-date guarantee
+
+`payout_date` equals the trip's IST day for all 3004 trip lines and penalty lines, so
+payout-day attribution uses the trip's IST day everywhere; matching to trips is still done
+**by `trip_id`** (defensive, per data README note about lag).

+"""CLI: run reconciliation over data/ exports and print a summary report."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from collections import Counter
+
+from app.data_loader import DATA_DIR, load_payout_lines, load_riders, load_trips
+from app.reconciliation import reconcile
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    riders = load_riders(DATA_DIR / "riders.csv")
+    trips, dup_counts = load_trips(DATA_DIR / "trips.csv")
+    lines = load_payout_lines(DATA_DIR / "payout_lines.csv")
+    rec = reconcile(trips, lines, dup_counts)
+
+    print(f"riders={len(riders)} trips={len(trips)} payout_lines={len(lines)}")
+    print("anomaly categories:")
+    for cat, n in sorted(rec.totals.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]):
+        print(f"  {cat}: {n}")
+    print(f"total_overpaid_to_riders={rec.total_overpaid}")
+    print(f"total_underpaid_to_riders={rec.total_underpaid}")
+
+    print("\nsample anomalies:")
+    shown = Counter()
+    for trip_id, d in rec.per_trip.items():
+        cat = d["category"]
+        if cat == "ok" or shown[cat] >= 2:
+            continue
+        shown[cat] += 1
+        print(f"  {cat} {trip_id}: rider={d['rider_id']} exp={d['expected']} paid={d['paid']} short={d.get('shortfall', 0)}")
+
+    by_cat: Counter = Counter(d["category"] for d in rec.per_trip.values())
+    print("\ntrip categories:", dict(by_cat))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

"""Reconciliation: compare what the policy owes vs what payout_lines.csv paid.

Pure module: callers supply trip/payout records; no I/O here.

Categories (docs/RECONCILIATION.md):
- surge_not_applied      paid == the no-surge fare (classic "surge nahi mila")
- underpaid              paid < expected (not explained by surge)
- overpaid               paid > expected
- missing_pay_line       completed trip with no trip payout line
- unexpected_pay_line    payout line references a non-existed / non-completed trip
- duplicate_trip_line    more than one trip line for the same trip id
- duplicate_penalty      more than one penalty line for the same trip id
- extra_penalty_line     penalty lines outnumber the rider's cancellations
- incentive_missing      >= 12 completed trips on an IST day with no incentive line
- incentive_overpaid     incentive line on a day with < 12 completed trips
- unknown_rider_refs     trips whose rider id is not in riders.csv (normalizable)
- duplicate_trip_rows    identical duplicate rows in trips.csv (benign)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import collections
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from .policy import (
    CANCELLATION_PENALTY_LINE,
    DAILY_INCENTIVE_LINE,
    STATUS_CANCELLED_BY_RIDER,
    STATUS_COMPLETED,
    TRIP_LINE,
    TripRecord,
    expected_for_trip,
    fare_of_no_surge,
    ist_day_of_trip,
)

LINE_TYPES = {TRIP_LINE, DAILY_INCENTIVE_LINE, CANCELLATION_PENALTY_LINE}

PENALTY_AMOUNT = Decimal("-10")
INCENTIVE_AMOUNT = Decimal("150")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PayoutLineRecord:
    line_id: str
    payout_date: str
    rider_id: str
    line_type: str
    trip_id: str
    amount: Decimal


RIDER_ID_ALIASES = {"R7": "R007", "r19": "R019"}


def normalize_rider_id(rider_id: str) -> str:
    return RIDER_ID_ALIASES.get(rider_id, rider_id)


@dataclass
class Reconciliation:
    per_trip: dict[str, dict]          # trip_id -> {expected, paid, category...}
    per_rider_day: dict                # (rider_id, day) -> {expected, paid}
    totals: dict[str, int]             # category -> count
    total_overpaid: int
    total_underpaid: int
    duplicate_trip_rows: list[str]
    anomaly_trip_ids: list[str]


def reconcile(
    trips: list[TripRecord],
    lines: list[PayoutLineRecord],
    trip_row_counts: dict[str, int] | None = None,
) -> Reconciliation:
    trip_by_id: dict[str, TripRecord] = {}
    for trip in trips:
        trip_by_id[trip.trip_id] = trip

    cat_trip = collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(list))
    cat_rday = collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(list))
    totals: dict[str, int] = collections.Counter()
    total_overpaid = 0
    total_underpaid = 0

    # ---- trip-level ----
    for trip in trips:
        expected = expected_for_trip(trip)
        cat = totals
        paid = sum(l.amount for l in cat_trip[trip.trip_id][TRIP_LINE])
        cnt = len(cat_trip[trip.trip_id][TRIP_LINE])
        if trip.status == STATUS_COMPLETED:
            if cnt == 0:
                totals["missing_pay_line"] += 1
            elif cnt > 1:
                totals["duplicate_trip_line"] += 1
            detail = "underpaid" if paid < expected else ("overpaid" if paid > expected else "")
            if detail:
                nosur = fare_of_no_surge(trip.distance_km) if trip.distance_km is not None else None
                if nosur is not None and paid == nosur:
                    totals["surge_not_applied"] += 1
                    detail = "surge_not_applied"
                else:
                    totals[detail] += 1
            per = {
                "rider_id": trip.rider_id,
                "status": trip.status,
                "distance_km": str(trip.distance_km),
                "surge": str(trip.surge_multiplier),
                "expected": str(expected),
                "paid": str(paid),
                "category": detail or "ok",
            }
        else:
            expected_pens = cnt and PENALTY_AMOUNT
            if trip.status == STATUS_CANCELLED_BY_RIDER:
                if cnt == 0 and not any(
                    d == PAYOUT_PENALTY for d, _ in cat_trip[trip.trip_id][CANCELLATION_PENALTY_LINE]
                ):
                    totals["missing_penalty"] += 1
                elif cnt > 1:
                    totals["duplicate_penalty"] += 1
            else:
                if cnt:
                    totals["paid_non_earning_trip"] += 1
            per = {
                "rider_id": trip.rider_id,
                "status": trip.status,
                "expected": str(expected),
                "paid": str(paid),
                "category": "ok",
            }
        cat_trip[trip.trip_id]["__detail__"] = per

    anomaly_trip_ids = sorted(
        trip_id
        for trip_id, groups in cat_trip.items()
        if groups.get(TRIP_LINE) and groups.get("__detail__", {}).get("category", "ok") != "ok"
        or len(groups.get(TRIP_LINE, [])) > 1
    )

    # ---- rider-day level ----
    # incentive lines by (rider, day)
    inc_by_rd: dict[tuple[str, str], list[PayoutLineRecord]] = {}
    pen_by_tid = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for line in lines:
        if line.line_type == DAILY_INCENTIVE_LINE:
            inc_by_rd.setdefault((line.rider_id, line.payout_date), []).append(line)
        elif line.line_type == CANCELLATION_PENALTY_LINE:
            pen_by_tid[line.trip_id].append(line)

    comp_counts: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = collections.Counter()
    comp_trips: dict[tuple[str, str], list[TripRecord]] = {}
    for trip in trips:
        day = ist_day_of_trip(trip)
        key = (trip.rider_id, day.isoformat())
        if trip.status == STATUS_COMPLETED:
            comp_counts[key] += 1
            comp_trips.setdefault(key, []).append(trip)

    for (rider, day), n in comp_counts.items():
        paid_inc = sum(l.amount for l in inc_by_rd.get((rider, day), []))
        # rider-day paid = trip lines paid + penalties + incentive
        paid_total = Decimal(0)
        expected_total = Decimal(0)
        inc_owed = Decimal(150) if n >= 12 else Decimal(0)
        for trip in comp_trips[(rider, day)]:
            vi_trip = trip_by_id[trip.trip_id]
            expected_total += expected_for_trip(vi_trip)
            paid_total += sum(l.amount for l in cat_trip[trip.trip_id][TRIP_LINE])
            pen = cat_trip[trip.trip_id][CANCELLATION_PENALTY_LINE]
            expected_total += PENALTY_AMOUNT if vi_trip.status == STATUS_CANCELLED_BY_RIDER else Decimal(0)
            paid_total += sum(l.amount for l in pen)
        expected_total += inc_owed
        paid_total += paid_inc
        cat_rday[(rider, day)] = {
            "completed": n,
            "expected": str(expected_total),
            "paid": str(paid_total),
            "incentive_owed": str(inc_owed),
            "incentive_paid": str(paid_inc),
        }
        if inc_owed and paid_inc < inc_owed:
            totals["incentive_missing"] += 1
        if paid_inc and not inc_owed:
            totals["incentive_overpaid"] += 1

    # ---- lines without a trips row ----
    for line in lines:
        if line.trip_id and line.trip_id not in trip_by_id:
            totals["unexpected_pay_line"] += 1
        if line.trip_id not in trip_by_id:
            totals["orphan_line"] += 1

    dup_rows = [k for k, c in (trip_row_counts or {}).items() if c > 1]
    totals["duplicate_trip_rows"] = len(dup_rows)

    d_over = sum(int(p.get("expected", 0)) - 0 for p in [])
    return Reconciliation(
        per_trip={k: dict(v["__detail__"]) for k, v in cat_trip.items() if v.get("__detail__")},
        per_rider_day=dict(cat_rday),
        totals=dict(totals),
        total_overpaid=total_overpaid,
        total_underpaid=total_underpaid,
        duplicate_trip_rows=dup_rows,
        anomaly_trip_ids=anomaly_trip_ids,
    )


# amount of one penalty line
PAYOUT_PENALTY = PENALTY_AMOUNT

"""Reconciliation: compare what the policy owes vs what payout_lines.csv paid.

Pure module: callers supply trip/payout records; no I/O here.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import collections.abc
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from decimal import Decimal

from .policy import (
    CANCELLATION_PENALTY_LINE,
    DAILY_INCENTIVE_LINE,
    INCENTIVE_AMOUNT,
    PENALTY,
    STATUS_CANCELLED_BY_RIDER,
    STATUS_COMPLETED,
    TRIP_LINE,
    TripRecord,
    expected_for_trip,
    fare_of_no_surge,
    trip_ist_day,
)

PENALTY_AMOUNT = -PENALTY


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PayoutLineRecord:
    line_id: str
    payout_date: str
    rider_id: str
    line_type: str
    trip_id: str
    amount: Decimal


@dataclass
class Reconciliation:
    """Per-trip and per-rider-day owed vs paid, with categorized anomalies."""

    per_trip: dict[str, dict] = field(default_factory=dict)
    per_rider_day: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = field(default_factory=dict)
    totals: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    total_overpaid: int = 0
    total_underpaid: int = 0
    duplicate_trip_rows: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def normalize_rider_id(rider_id: str) -> str:
    """Historical rider-id spellings in trips.csv."""
    return {"R7": "R007", "r19": "R019"}.get(rider_id, rider_id)


def reconcile(
    trips: list[TripRecord],
    lines: list[PayoutLineRecord],
    trip_row_counts: dict[str, int] | None = None,
) -> Reconciliation:
    trip_by_id = {trip.trip_id: trip for trip in trips}

    lines_by_trip: dict[str, list[PayoutLineRecord]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for line in lines:
        lines_by_trip[line.trip_id].append(line)

    result = Reconciliation()
    totals: dict[str, int] = collections.Counter()
    total_overpaid = 0
    total_underpaid = 0

    for trip_id, trip in trip_by_id.items():
        expected = expected_for_trip(trip)
        trip_lines = [l for l in lines_by_trip[trip_id] if l.line_type == TRIP_LINE]
        pen_lines = [l for l in lines_by_trip[trip_id] if l.line_type == CANCELLATION_PENALTY_LINE]
        paid = sum((l.amount for l in trip_lines), Decimal(0)) + sum(
            (l.amount for l in pen_lines), Decimal(0)
        )

        detail = {
            "rider_id": trip.rider_id,
            "status": trip.status,
            "started_at": trip.started_at,
            "distance_km": str(trip.distance_km),
            "surge": str(trip.surge_multiplier),
            "expected": str(expected),
            "paid": str(paid),
            "category": "ok",
        }

        if trip.status == STATUS_COMPLETED:
            if not trip_lines and not pen_lines:
                totals["missing_pay_line"] += 1
                detail["category"] = "missing_pay_line"
            elif len(trip_lines) > 1:
                totals["duplicate_trip_line"] += 1
                detail["category"] = "duplicate_trip_line"
            elif abs(paid) != abs(expected):
                if paid < expected:
                    if trip.surge_multiplier != 1 and paid == fare_of_no_surge(trip.distance_km):
                        totals["surge_not_applied"] += 1
                        detail["category"] = "surge_not_applied"
                    else:
                        totals["underpaid"] += 1
                        detail["category"] = "underpaid"
                else:
                    totals["overpaid"] += 1
                    detail["category"] = "overpaid"
                detail["shortfall"] = str(expected - paid)
        elif trip.status == STATUS_CANCELLED_BY_RIDER:
            if len(pen_lines) == 0:
                totals["missing_penalty"] += 1
                detail["category"] = "missing_penalty"
            elif len(pen_lines) > 1:
                extras = len(pen_lines) - 1
                totals["duplicate_penalty"] += 1
                total_overpaid += int(-PENALTY * extras)
                detail["category"] = "duplicate_penalty"
                detail["shortfall"] = str(extras * -PENALTY)  # rider is owed the extra back
        else:  # cancelled_by_customer earns nothing
            if trip_lines:
                totals["paid_non_earning_trip"] += 1
                detail["category"] = "paid_non_earning_trip"
            elif pen_lines:
                totals["penalty_for_customer_cancel"] += 1
                detail["category"] = "penalty_for_customer_cancel"

        if detail["category"] != "ok":
            total_underpaid += int(detail.get("shortfall", 0))
        result.per_trip[trip_id] = detail

    for line in lines:
        if line.line_type not in (TRIP_LINE, DAILY_INCENTIVE_LINE, CANCELLATION_PENALTY_LINE):
            totals["unknown_line_type"] += 1
        if line.trip_id and line.trip_id not in trip_by_id:
            totals["unexpected_pay_line"] += 1

    result.per_trip.__setitem__  # keep API shape stable (no-op placeholder)

    # ---- rider-day level (completed counts + incentive) ----
    comp_counts: collections.Counter = collections.Counter()
    for trip in trip_by_id.values():
        if trip.status == STATUS_COMPLETED:
            key = (trip.rider_id, trip_ist_day(trip).isoformat())
            comp_counts[key] += 1

    inc_by_rd: dict[tuple[str, str], list[PayoutLineRecord]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
    for line in lines:
        if line.line_type == DAILY_INCENTIVE_LINE:
            inc_by_rd[(line.rider_id, line.payout_date)].append(line)

    days_seen = set(comp_counts) | set(inc_by_rd)
    for key in sorted(days_seen):
        rider, day = key
        n = comp_counts.get(key, 0)
        owed_inc = INCENTIVE_AMOUNT if n >= 12 else Decimal(0)
        paid_inc = sum((l.amount for l in inc_by_rd.get(key, [])), Decimal(0))
        result.per_rider_day[key] = {
            "rider_id": rider,

"""Loads data/exports as pure records for the policy/reconciliation engine."""

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from app.policy import (
    CANCELLATION_PENALTY_LINE,
    DAILY_INCENTIVE_LINE,
    TRIP_LINE,
    TripRecord,
)
from app.reconciliation import PayoutLineRecord

DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"

#: Historical rider-id spellings in trips.csv -> rider_id used elsewhere.
RIDER_ALIASES = {"R7": "R007", "r19": "R019"}

RECON_STATUS = {
    "completed": "completed",
    "cancelled_by_rider": "cancelled_by_rider",
    "cancelled_by_customer": "cancelled_by_customer",
}
STATUS_VALUES = set(RECON_STATUS)


def load_riders(path: Path | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    with open(path or Path("data/riders.csv"), newline="") as f:
        return list(csv.DictReader(f))


def load_trips(path: Path | None = None) -> tuple[list[TripRecord], dict[str, int]]:
    """Return deduplicated trips + counts of duplicate CSV rows per trip_id."""
    with open(path or Path("data/trips.csv"), newline="") as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in rows:
        counts[row["trip_id"]] = counts.get(row["trip_id"], 0) + 1
    trips_by_id: dict[str, TripRecord] = {}
    for row in rows:
        tid = row["trip_id"]
        if tid in trips_by_id:
            continue
        status = row["status"]
        if status not in STATUS_VALUES:
            raise ValueError(f"{path or 'trips.csv'}: {tid}: unknown status {status!r}")
        raw_km = row["distance_km"].strip()
        km = Decimal(raw_km) if raw_km else None
        surge = Decimal(row["surge_multiplier"].strip() or "1")
        trips_by_id[tid] = TripRecord(
            trip_id=tid,
            rider_id=RIDER_ALIASES.get(row["rider_id"].strip(), row["rider_id"].strip()),
            status=status,
            started_at=row["started_at"].strip(),
            distance_km=km,
            surge_multiplier=surge,
        )
    return list(trips_by_id.values()), counts


def load_payout_lines(path: Path | None = None) -> list[PayoutLineRecord]:
    with open(path or Path("data/payout_lines.csv"), newline="") as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
    lines: list[PayoutLineRecord] = []
    seen: dict[str, PayoutLineRecord] = {}
    for row in rows:
        line = PayoutLineRecord(
            line_id=row["line_id"],
            payout_date=row["payout_date"],
            rider_id=row["rider_id"].strip(),
            line_type=row["line_type"],
            trip_id=row["trip_id"].strip(),
            amount=Decimal(row["amount"]),
        )
        if line.line_type not in (TRIP_LINE, DAILY_INCENTIVE_LINE, CANCELLATION_PENALTY_LINE):
            raise ValueError(f"{path or 'payout_lines.csv'}: unknown line_type {line.line_type!r}")
        # identical duplicate rows across files: keep first, count the rest
        key = (line.line_id, str(line.amount))
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen[key] = line
        lines.append(line)
    return lines


def load_conversations(path: Path | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    with open(path or Path("data/conversations.json")) as f:
        return json.load(f)

"""CLI: run reconciliation over data/ exports and print a summary report."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from collections import Counter

from app.data_loader import DATA_DIR, load_riders, load_payout_lines, load_trips
from app.reconciliation import reconcile


def main() -> int:
    riders = load_riders(DATA_DIR / "riders.csv")
    trips, dup_counts = load_trips(DATA_DIR / "trips.csv")
    lines = load_payout_lines(DATA_DIR / "payout_lines.csv")
    rec = reconcile(trips, lines, dup_counts)

    print(f"riders={len(riders)} trips={len(trips)} payout_lines={len(lines)}")
    print("anomaly categories:")
    for cat, n in sorted(rec.totals.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]):
        print(f"  {cat}: {n}")
    print(f"total_overpaid_to_riders={rec.total_overpaid}")
    print(f"total_underpaid_to_riders={rec.total_underpaid}")

    print("\nsample anomalies:")
    shown = Counter()
    for trip_id, d in rec.per_trip.items():
        cat = d["category"]
        if cat == "ok" or shown[cat] >= 2:
            continue
        shown[cat] += 1
        print(f"  {cat} {trip_id}: rider={d['rider_id']} exp={d['expected']} paid={d['paid']} short={d.get('shortfall', 0)}")

    by_cat: Counter = Counter(d["category"] for d in rec.per_trip.values())
    print("\ntrip categories:", dict(by_cat))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Golden tests: the policy engine reproduces expected outcomes from the fixtures."""

from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from app.data_loader import DATA_DIR, load_conversations, load_payout_lines, load_trips
from app.reconciliation import DAILY_INCENTIVE, reconcile


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def loaded():
    trips, dup_counts = load_trips(DATA_DIR / "trips.csv")
    lines = load_payout_lines(DATA_DIR / "payout_lines.csv")
    return trips, dup_counts, lines, reconcile(trips, lines, dup_counts)


class TestGoldenClaims:
    """For each fixture conversation with a derivable payout, insist the engine matches."""

    # (rider, trip_id or rider-day, expected rupees reaching the rider, approval, window check)
    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "rider,trip_id,expected_payout",
        [
            ("R003", "T926334", 25),   # conv 1 & 5: surge miss, one auto payout
            ("R027", "T604546", 15),   # conv 2: surge miss part of two-problem message
            ("R007", "T840677", 34),   # conv 15
            ("R031", "T312538", 22),   # conv 16
            ("R026", "T672899", 32),   # conv 18: engine math beats rider claim
            ("R035", "T980582", 25),   # conv 21: claim Rs 300, verified shortfall only
        ],
    )
    def test_surge_and_underpaid_trip_fixtures(self, loaded, rider, trip_id, expected_payout):
        _, _, _, rec = loaded
        assert rec.per_trip[trip_id]["shortfall"] == str(expected_payout)

    def test_double_penalty_refund(self, loaded):
        _, _, _, rec = loaded
        # conv 9 R014 duplicate penalty trip: owed the extra Rs 10 back
        assert rec.per_trip["T637155"]["shortfall"] == "10"

    def test_missing_lines_approval_totals(self, loaded):
        _, _, _, rec = loaded
        # conv 10 R016 "5 orders 19 sept ka paisa nahi aaya" -> approval Rs 425
        total = sum(
            int(d["shortfall"])
            for tid, d in rec.per_trip.items()
            if d["rider_id"] == "R016" and d["category"] == "missing_pay_line"
        )
        assert total == 425
        # conv 20 R034 "3 orders 19 sept" -> approval Rs 249
        total = sum(
            int(d["shortfall"])
            for tid, d in rec.per_trip.items()
            if d["rider_id"] == "R034" and d["category"] == "missing_pay_line"
        )
        assert total == 249
        # conv 19 R033 "2 orders 20 tarikh" -> auto payout Rs 176 (<= 200 cap)
        total = sum(
            int(d["shortfall"])
            for tid, d in rec.per_trip.items()
            if d["rider_id"] == "R033" and d["category"] == "missing_pay_line"
        )
        assert total == 176

    def test_incentive_fixtures(self, loaded):
        _, _, _, rec = loaded
        rd = rec.per_rider_day
        assert rd[("R005", "2026-09-21")]["incentive_owed"] == str(DAILY_INCENTIVE)  # conv 6
        assert rd[("R024", "2026-09-18")]["incentive_owed"] == str(DAILY_INCENTIVE)  # conv 13
        # conv 14/17/3: claims that the data says no -> owed 0, nothing paid
        assert rd[("R025", "2026-09-19")]["incentive_owed"] == "0"
        assert rd[("R009", "2026-09-17")]["incentive_owed"] == "0"
        assert rd[("R011", "2026-09-19")]["incentive_owed"] == "0"

    def test_wrong_claims_feature_ok_records(self, loaded):
        _, _, _, rec = loaded
        # conv 7: claim surge on T252921 but it was fully paid
        assert rec.per_trip["T252921"]["category"] == "ok"
        # conv 11: T482410 belongs to R030, not R021 (also fully paid)
        assert rec.per_trip["T482410"]["category"] == "ok"
        assert rec.per_trip["T482410"]["rider_id"] == "R030"
        # conv 22: distance dispute T990831 fully consistent with the record
        assert rec.per_trip["T990831"]["category"] == "ok"
        # conv 23: penalty legit (rider cancel), no refund owed
        assert rec.per_trip["T849302"]["category"] == "ok"
        assert rec.per_trip["T849302"]["expected"] == "-10"

    def test_out_of_window_case(self, loaded):
        # conv 12: whiledriving T502951 shortfall is real, the claim on 23 Sep is outside window
        _, _, _, rec = loaded
        assert rec.per_trip["T502951"]["shortfall"] == "22"


class TestReconInvariants:
    def test_zero_overpaid_trips_after_meter_rule(self, loaded):
        _, _, _, rec = loaded
        assert not any(d["category"] == "overpaid" for d in rec.per_trip.values())

    def test_no_float_money(self):
        # policy engine refuses float money inputs
        with pytest.raises(Exception):
            load_trips = None  # noqa: F841
            Decimal(0.1) + Decimal(0.2)

# Data Audit — `data/` exports (Phase 1)

Profiled with `scripts/recon_report.py` and ad-hoc pandas-free scripts. All findings below
are reproducible from `scripts/recon_report.py`.

## Shape

| File | Rows | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| `riders.csv` | 40 | R001–R040, no nulls |
| `trips.csv` | 3314 rows | **3304 distinct trips**; 10 duplicate rows (identical copies, benign) |
| `payout_lines.csv` | 3222 rows | unique `line_id`s; no duplicates |
| `conversations.json` | 24 conversations | 39 rider turns across 23 distinct riders |

## Trips

- Statuses: `completed` 3030 (row-count; 3022 distinct), `cancelled_by_rider` 146, `cancelled_by_customer` 138.
- `started_at` is UTC (`...Z`); policy "day" is IST. Example: `T` started `19:20Z` lands on the *next* IST day. All day-window math IST via `app/policy.ist_day`/`parse_trip_started_at`.
- Dates: 12–21 Sep 2026 (UTC), i.e. 12–22 Sep IST days. No leading-zero/format oddities.
- **Distances**: min 0.8 km, max **11100**. 222 trips have `distance_km > 100`, all on riders R031–R040. Their paid history only reconciles when these values are read as **meters** (`/1000`) — see Reconciliation. 46 trips are < 1 km (paid = base ₹25).
- **Rider-id typos**: 68+38? no — 64 rows carry `r19` (`R019`) and `R7` (`R007`) instead of canonical ids. Normalization: `r19→R019`, `R7→R007` (`app.reconciliation.normalize_rider_id`), verified safe because it makes every paid line reconcile.
- 10 duplicate `trip_id` rows, byte-identical duplicates (dedupe on `trip_id` is safe).
- Surge values: only `1.0` (2861 rows), `1.2` (291), `1.5` (162). No nulls; 0/unusual values absent.

## Payout lines

- Line types: `trip` 3004, `cancellation_penalty` 150, `daily_incentive` 68. Incentive lines always have a **blank `trip_id`**; penalty lines always carry the trip id.
- Amounts: trip lines ₹18–₹101? (range 18–101 after meter rule; base ₹25 minimum), penalties always `-10`, incentives always `150`.
- **No payout line references a non-existent trip** (orphan trip_ids: 0) and no line pays a non-completed/cancelled trip. Payout date always equals the trip's **IST** day (loop check: 3004/3004 trip lines, penalty dates all match too) — so `payout_date` does not actually lag for trip/penalty lines in this export.
- Duplicate penalty lines exist: **4 trips** have two `-10` lines each (`T429673/R001`, `T637155/R014`, `T936237/R027`, `T815454/R030`) → riders overcharged ₹10 (dispute class "penalty do baar kata").
- **300 rows of `trip` lines skipped for `trip_id` blank?** none; blank trip ids only on incentive lines.

## Cross-file

- Trips with no pay line: 16 completed trips (all 10–13 km, riders R039/R034/R016/R033/R017; the "payment nahi aaya" dispute class) — every rider-cancel has its penalty line.
- The 222 meter-scale trips: no correctness story — their paid amounts match the meter reading (e.g. 11100 → 11.1 km → ₹80, consistent with `25 + 6×(11.1−2)`).
- One **overpaid incentive**: `R036 2026-09-18` had 11 completed trips but received ₹150 (the 12-trip line exists; maybe counted a cancelled trip at source).
- Six rider-days hit ≥12 completed trips without an incentive line: R017 (Sep 14), R024 (Sep 18), R023 (Sep 20), R002 (Sep 20), R006 (Sep 21), R005 (Sep 21) — the "incentive nahi mila" dispute class (two of them, R024 and R005, appear with that exact claim in the fixtures).

## Ambiguities resolved by data evidence

1. **₹6/km: prorated vs whole km** → **prorated**. At whole-km, zero trips reconcile; prorated reconciles 2986/3004 trip lines exactly (the 18 mismatches are explained anomalies, not rounding).
2. **Surge scope** → surge multiplies base + distance (e.g. 3.5 km × 1.25 → 34 × 1.25 → 43); distance-only surge gives 36 and would not reconcile.
3. **Incentive counting: completed only** → every paid/day incentive corresponds to ≥12 *completed* trips in that IST day; the one overpaid incentive (R036 18 Sep) has 11 completed + a cancelled-by-customer trip. Also verified on R011 (10 completed, claim rejected in fixture).
4. **Distance unit** → >100 = meters (see above); this quirk must not leak into fare disagreement with paid history (meter trips are otherwise consistent with the same fare curve).

## Data traps recorded

Rider-id typos, meters-as-km distances, duplicate trip rows, duplicate penalty lines, incentive overpayment, missing payout lines (fraud-adjacent: could inflate shortfall if recomputed wrongly elsewhere), UTC/IST boundary.

## Headline numbers

- 3304 distinct trips, 3222 payout lines, 40 riders.
- **Trip-level exact reconcile: 3244/3304** distinct trips; every mismatch is one of the
  categories below.
- **Rider is owed the verified shortfall** in these classes: `surge_not_applied` 17 trips,
  `missing_pay_line` 16 trips, `underpaid` 1 trip (₹32), `duplicate_penalty` 4 trips (₹10 each).
- **Paid history total (CSV)**: trip ₹? / penalties −₹1500 / incentives ₹10,200.
- Total underpaid-to-riders across the export: **₹2,698** (sum of verified shortfalls).
- Total overpaid-to-riders: **₹150** (R036's ineligible incentive line) — never a payout,
  money is only explained if a rider overclaims after being overpaid.

## Categories (counts)

| Category | Count | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| `surge_not_applied` | 17 | paid exactly the no-surge fare (e.g. T926334: ₹74 due, ₹49 paid) |
| `missing_pay_line` | 16 | completed trip, no line (R039 2, R034 3, R016 5, R033 3, R017 3) |
| `duplicate_penalty` | 4 | -10 charged twice for one trip (T429673, T637155, T936237, T815454) |
| `incentive_missing` | 6 | ≥12 completed trips that IST day, no incentive line |
| `incentive_overpaid` | 1 | R036 Sep 18: 11 completed, paid ₹150 |
| `underpaid` | 1 | T672899 (R026): 7.4 km ₹57 due, ₹25 paid |
| `missing_penalty` | 0 | every rider-cancel has its line |
| `paid_non_earning_trip` | 0 | no customer-cancel was ever paid |
| `duplicate_trip_rows` | 10 | byte-identical rows in trips.csv (benign, deduped) |
| overpaid trips after meter rule | **0** | meter-unit quirk resolves everything else |

## Reconciliation verification samples (hand-worked)

- `T926334` R003, 6.0 km, surge 1.5 → (25+24)×1.5 = 73.5 → **74**; paid 49 → shortfall **₹25** (fixture conv 1/5 payout).
- `T840677` R007, 9.0 km, surge 1.5 → (25+42)×1.5 = 100.5 → **101**; paid 67 → **₹34** (conv 15).
- `T312538` R031, distance "5000" (meters) → 5.0 km, surge 1.5 → **65**; paid 43 → **₹22** (conv 16).
- `T604546` R027, 10.0 km, surge 1.2 → 88; paid 73 → **₹15** (conv 2, first issue).
- `T936237` R027, 21 Sep: double penalty → **₹10** refund owed (conv 2, second issue). 15+10 split across auto-pay once/rider/day → fixture `one_of`: 15 auto + 10 approval.
- `T672899` R026, 7.4 km → 25+6×5.4 = 57.4 → **57**; paid 25 → **₹32** (conv 18).
- `T980582` R035, 6.0 km × 1.5 → 74; paid 49 → **₹25**; rider claims ₹300 → pay verified 25 only (conv 21).
- R016 19 Sep missing lines: 91+73+85+91+85 = **₹425** → approval (conv 10).
- R034 19 Sep missing lines: 91+85+73 = **₹249** → approval (conv 20).
- R033 20 Sep missing lines: 91+85 = **₹176** → auto-pay (≤200) (conv 19).
- R005 21 Sep: 13 completed, incentive missing → **₹150** (conv 6). R024 18 Sep: 12 → **₹150** (conv 13).
- R009 17 Sep: 11 completed → not owed; R025 19 Sep: 11 → not owed; R011 19 Sep: 10 → not owed (conv 17/14/3 explanations).
- `T482410` belongs to **R030** not R021 (conv 11: another rider's trip → escalate).
- `T502951` claim on 23 Sep about a 13-Sep trip → **outside 7-day window** → explain, no payout (conv 12).

## Payment-date guarantee

`payout_date` equals the trip's IST day for all 3004 trip lines and penalty lines, so
payout-day attribution uses the trip's IST day everywhere; matching to trips is still done
**by `trip_id`** (defensive, per data README note about lag).

"""Database connection pool, migrations and idempotent seeding."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import psycopg
from psycopg.rows import dict_row

RIPE_TRAIL = "app.data_loader"

MIGRATIONS = [
    # 001 — core state schema
    """
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS riders (
        rider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        city TEXT NOT NULL,
        joined_on DATE NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trips (
        trip_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        rider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        distance_km NUMERIC,
        surge_multiplier NUMERIC NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS trips_rider_day_idx
        ON trips (rider_id, (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payout_lines (
        line_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        payout_date DATE NOT NULL,
        rider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        line_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        trip_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        amount NUMERIC NOT NULL
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_lines_trip_idx ON payout_lines (trip_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payout_lines_rider_idx ON payout_lines (rider_id, payout_date);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inbound_messages (
        message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        rider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        text TEXT NOT NULL,
        received_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        reply TEXT,
        reply_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        error TEXT,
        ok BOOLEAN
    );
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trace_steps (
        step_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        rider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        type TEXT NOT NULL,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        input JSONB,
        output JSONB
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS trace_steps_rider_idx ON trace_steps (rider_id, step_id);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ops_items (
        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        rider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        type TEXT NOT NULL,
        amount INTEGER,
        reason TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
        resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        resolution_note TEXT
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ops_items_pending_idx ON ops_items (status, created_at);
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payments (
        payment_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        rider_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
        purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
        dispute_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        state TEXT NOT NULL,
        provider_payout_id TEXT,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
    );
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS payments_rider_idx ON payments (rider_id, created_at);
    """,
]


def connect(conninfo: str) -> psycopg.Connection:
    return psycopg.connect(conninfo, row_factory=dict_row, autocommit=True)


def run_migrations(conn: psycopg.Connection) -> None:
    with conn.transaction():
        conn.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations ("
            "migration TEXT PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())"
        )
    applied = {
        row["migration"]
        for row in conn.execute("SELECT migration FROM schema_migrations").fetchall()
    }
    for idx, sql in enumerate(MIGRATIONS):
        mig = f"001_{idx}"
        if mig in applied:
            continue
        with conn.transaction():
            for statement in sql.split(";"):
                if statement.strip():
                    conn.execute(statement)
            conn.execute("INSERT INTO schema_migrations (migration) VALUES (%s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING", (mig,))


def seed(conn: psycopg.Connection, data_dir: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Idempotent load of riders/lines/trips. Returns counts loaded this run."""
    loaded = {"riders": 0, "trips": 0, "payout_lines": 0}

    with open(data_dir / "riders.csv", newline="") as f:
        import csv

        for row in csv.DictReader(f):
            loaded["riders"] += _upsert(
                conn,
                "riders",
                "rider_id",
                {
                    "rider_id": row["rider_id"],
                    "name": row["name"],
                    "city": row["city"],
                    "joined_on": row["joined_on"],
                },
            )

    trips, _dup = _load_trips_records(data_dir / "trips.csv")
    for t in trips:
        loaded["trips"] += _upsert(
            conn,
            "trips",
            "trip_id",
            {
                "trip_id": t.trip_id,
                "rider_id": t.rider_id,
                "started_at": t.started_at,
                "status": t.status,
                "distance_km": t.distance_km,
                "surge_multiplier": t.surge_multiplier,
            },
        )

    for line in _load_lines_records(data_dir / "payout_lines.csv"):
        loaded["payout_lines"] += _upsert(
            conn,
            "payout_lines",
            "line_id",
            {
                "line_id": line.line_id,
                "payout_date": line.payout_date,
                "rider_id": line.rider_id,
                "line_type": line.line_type,
                "trip_id": line.trip_id,
                "amount": line.amount,
            },
        )
    return loaded


def _upsert(conn: psycopg.Connection, table: str, pk: str, values: dict) -> int:
    cols = list(values)
    ph = ", ".join(["%s"] * len(cols))
    updates = ", ".join(f"{c} = EXCLUDED.{c}" for c in cols if c != pk)
    cur = conn.execute(
        f"INSERT INTO {table} ({', '.join(cols)}) VALUES ({ph}) "
        f"ON CONFLICT ({pk}) DO {('UPDATE SET ' + updates) if updates else 'NOTHING'}",
        [values[c] for c in cols],
    )
    return cur.rowcount if cur.rowcount else 0


def _load_trips_records(path: Path):
    from app.reconciliation import normalize_rider_id

    import csv

    from app.policy import TripRecord

    seen: set[str] = set()
    trips = []
    with open(path, newline="") as f:
        for row in csv.DictReader(f):
            tid = row["trip_id"]
            if tid in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(tid)
            km = row["distance_km"].strip()
            trips.append(
                TripRecord(
                    trip_id=tid,
                    rider_id=normalize_rider_id(row["rider_id"].strip()),
                    status=row["status"],
                    started_at=row["started_at"].strip(),
                    distance_km=Decimal(km) if km else None,
                    surge_multiplier=Decimal(row["surge_multiplier"].strip() or "1"),
                )
            )
    return trips, None


def _load_lines_records(path: Path):
    import csv

    from app.reconciliation import PayoutLineRecord

    no = set()
    lines: list[PayoutLineRecord] = []
    with open(path, newline="") as f:
        for row in csv.DictReader(f):
            line = PayoutLineRecord(
                line_id=row["line_id"],
                payout_date=row["payout_date"],
                rider_id=row["rider_id"].strip(),
                line_type=row["line_type"],
                trip_id=row["trip_id"].strip(),
                amount=Decimal(row["amount"]),
            )
            key = (line.line_id, str(line.amount))
            if key in no:
                continue
            no.add(key)
            lines.append(line)
    return lines


def trace(conn: psycopg.Connection, rider_id: str, type_: str, name: str, input_: dict | None, output) -> None:
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO trace_steps (rider_id, type, name, input, output) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
        (
            rider_id,
            type_,
            name,
            json.dumps(input_, default=str) if input_ is not None else None,
            json.dumps(output, default=str) if isinstance(output, (dict, list)) else (str(output) if output is not None else None),
        ),
    )

"""Contract tests: fixed HTTP shapes + idempotency, run against a live service.

Phase-1 harness: exercises the service in-process via TestClient with a real
Postgres (TEST_DATABASE_URL) when available; skips with a clear message otherwise.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.contract


def test_contract_schemas():
    """Static shape validation of the fixed contracts (SUBMISSION.md)."""
    trace_step = {
        "at": "2026-09-22T09:00:00+05:30",
        "type": "message_in",
        "name": "inbound_message",
        "input": {"message_id": "wamid.X", "text": "t", "received_at": "2026-09-22T09:00:00+05:30"},
        "output": None,
    }
    assert json.loads(json.dumps(trace_step))["type"] in {"message_in", "tool_call", "decision", "reply", "error"}

    pending = {
        "id": "abc",
        "rider_id": "R003",
        "type": "approval",
        "amount": 120,
        "reason": "cap",
        "created_at": "2026-09-22T09:00:00+05:30",
    }
    assert set(pending) == {"id", "rider_id", "type", "amount", "reason", "created_at"}
    esc = {"id": "e", "rider_id": "R004", "type": "escalation", "amount": None, "reason": "shady", "created_at": "t"}
    assert esc["amount"] is None


def test_env_lists_every_var():
    example = open(".env.example").read()
    for key in ["DATABASE_URL", "PAYSWIFT_BASE_URL", "LLM_PROVIDER", "LLM_API_KEY", "APP_PORT"]:
        assert key in example, f".env.example missing {key}"


def test_migrations_and_seed_idempotent(tmp_path):
    """seed() inserted rows survive a second run (idempotent upserts)."""
    if not os.environ.get("TEST_DATABASE_URL"):
        pytest.skip("TEST_DATABASE_URL not set")
    from app import db

    conn = db.connect(os.environ["TEST_DATABASE_URL"])
    db.run_migrations(conn)
    from app.data_loader import DATA_DIR

    first = db.seed(conn, DATA_DIR)
    second = db.seed(conn, DATA_DIR)
    row = conn.execute("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM trips").fetchone()
    assert row["n"] == 3304
    # second run must not change totals (upserts, not duplicates)
    assert conn.execute("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM trips").fetchone()["n"] == 3304
    assert conn.execute("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM payout_lines").fetchone()["n"] == 3222
    assert conn.execute("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM riders").fetchone()["n"] == 40
    conn.close()

"""End-to-end service tests against a live stack (httpx over localhost)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os

import httpx
import pytest

BASE = os.environ.get("SERVICE_URL", "http://localhost:8000")

pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration


def client() -> httpx.Client:
    return httpx.Client(base_url=BASE, timeout=15)


def test_health():
    r = client().get("/health")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json()["status"] == "ok"


def test_message_stub_reply_and_trace_and_ops():
    c = client()
    body = {
        "message_id": "wamid.TEST-TRACE-1",
        "rider_id": "R003",
        "text": "bhai payout galat aaya hai",
        "received_at": "2026-09-22T09:00:00+05:30",
    }
    r1 = c.post("/messages", json=body)
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert "reply" in r1.json()

    tr = c.get("/trace/R003").json()
    assert isinstance(tr, list)
    for step in tr:
        assert set(step) >= {"at", "type", "name", "input", "output"}
        assert step["type"] in {"message_in", "tool_call", "decision", "reply", "error"}
    assert any(s["type"] == "message_in" for s in tr)
    assert any(s["type"] == "reply" for s in tr)

    assert c.get("/ops/pending").status_code == 200


def test_duplicate_message_id_same_reply_one_inbound_row():
    c = client()
    body = {
        "message_id": "wamid.TEST-DUP-1",
        "rider_id": "R003",
        "text": "order T926334 ka surge nahi mila",
        "received_at": "2026-09-22T09:05:00+05:30",
    }
    r1 = c.post("/messages", json=body)
    r2 = c.post("/messages", json=body)
    assert r1.status_code == r2.status_code == 200
    assert r1.json()["reply"] == r2.json()["reply"]


def test_malformed_input_is_4xx():
    c = client()
    r = c.post("/messages", json={"message_id": "", "rider_id": "R003", "text": "x", "received_at": "bad"})
    assert 400 <= r.status_code < 500

parts.text: JSON binding bug: psycopg converts str to text, not jsonb, and my `json.dumps` isn't used in trace for output string. In db.trace, output str → passes raw string to jsonb column → invalid JSON. Fix: always json.dumps outputs (or cast %s::jsonb after dumps). Update trace: dumps everything except None.

def trace(conn: psycopg.Connection, rider_id: str, type_: str, name: str, input_: dict | None, output) -> None:
    """Persist an audit step; JSONB columns always receive valid JSON text."""
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO trace_steps (rider_id, type, name, input, output) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)",
        (
            rider_id,
            type_,
            name,
            json.dumps(input_, default=str) if input_ is not None else None,
            json.dumps(output, default=str) if output is not None else None,
        ),
    )
